name: – David McAllister – § 45 – Am 16
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 45. Reaffirms that, in accordance with Article 24 TEU, the CFSP is an intergovernmental competence requiring unanimity for binding decisions, guaranteeing the sovereign right of each Member State to protect its own national strategic interests; acknowledges the concerns of some Member States, which fear a decreased ability to influence foreign and security policy at EU level;
